profile: One authored post-readiness origin-style worker; event/ledger before worker; no original raw script playback.
noMatchRelease: Accepted no-op outside Holding; never deferred.

cases.action: Missing prepared definition/resource readiness or mismatched owner
cases.expected: Reject before worker/ledger admission, with no consumed identity or output.

cases.action: Admit the selected worker at tick 0
cases.expected: Task class 54; all initial counters/layout retained; no tile submission at birth.

cases.action: Advance from tick 0 to 1
cases.expected: Emit pre-update radius/angle 0/0 as a zero-area quad, then store 4/64; no early completion.

cases.action: Advance a cell with initial delay 1
cases.expected: First update decrements to zero without a draw; next update emits its zero-area birth shape.

cases.setup: Strict entry overshoot and extra pass
cases.action: Advance the selected full grid through ticks 54 and 55
cases.expected: Tick 54 first latches all-finished; tick 55 emits the extra tile pass and changes class 54 to 55.

cases.action: Parent polls class 54 before worker each tick
cases.expected: Pending at 55; observes no class 54 at 56 while class 55 remains live.

cases.action: Read accepted tick 55 then advance 56
cases.expected: Tick 55 retains last tile draw; first flash submission is 56, with selected shared RGB.

cases.action: Supply many ticks and Circle samples without Release
cases.expected: Remain class 55; Circle never releases or advances the leaving phase.

cases.action: Signal Release while worker is Entering
cases.expected: Accepted no-op; no queued signal; later Holding still waits for a new release.

cases.action: Hold is born at tick 55; next event-phase signal is tick 56
cases.expected: Release can act at 56; do not execute another event/worker pass at tick 55.

cases.action: Signal Release in event phase at tick 100
cases.expected: Class becomes 54; worker emits one final flash, resets delays and reaches leaving first yield without a tile step.

cases.action: Advance release tick 101 with a positive-delay tile
cases.expected: Emit its full stored shape while decrementing delay; no hidden waiting tile in phase 1.

cases.action: Observe final active steps and zero-size geometry
cases.expected: Remain busy while either unclamped counter is nonnegative; preserve the overshoot and extra body pass.

cases.action: Release at 100, advance through 155/156
cases.expected: Last release body and one-frame exit wait at 155 retain class 54; task clears at 156.

cases.action: Parent E5 polls before worker
cases.expected: Parent remains blocked at 156 and resumes at 157; no renderer completion input.

cases.action: Release again while Leaving or after worker completion
cases.expected: No-match no-op; never restart, revive or shorten the worker.

cases.action: Run Entering/Holding/Leaving/Completed
cases.expected: Same logical task ID and owner, revisions 0/1/2/3, retained completed tombstone and correct active classes.

cases.action: Reject after a candidate start consumes the remaining budget
cases.expected: Restore exact input state, empty trace and unused task identity.

cases.action: Reject the phase publication after candidate tick-55 work
cases.expected: Roll back tick, counters, draw, ledger revision and barrier facts together.

cases.action: Reject after candidate release/signal in an ordered tick
cases.expected: Roll back both event and worker changes; retry publishes the release once.

cases.action: Reject final candidate task completion
cases.expected: Keep prior state/trace/identity unchanged; no parent success or terminal fact escapes.

cases.action: Read/omit/repeat draws and recreate resources around identical explicit commands
cases.expected: Full accepted state and trace replay match; presentation cannot change task lifetime or clock.

cases.action: Supply other modes, reserved prefix, steps, divisor zero or final-battle image 1
cases.expected: Reject as unsupported before start; document native division trap instead of inventing clamping.

cases.action: Attempt a second live DarkScreen, foreign binding or external stale ledger facts
cases.expected: Reject atomically; no concurrent native burst-pool emulation or guessed multi-slot selector.

cases.action: Use the bounded delay data and Q12 rotation samples
cases.expected: All 288 source-traced delays and 117 selected projections match, with signed truncation and no ideal-trig substitution.

cases.action: Compose tile/flash over an explicit RGB5 background
cases.expected: No texture/palette/STP test; use selected average material, explicit state and correct clipping before RGB5 expansion.

cases.action: Compose degenerate, shared-edge and overlapping rotated quads
cases.expected: Preserve two-triangle single coverage and reverse native submission order; do not union overlapping tiles.

cases.action: Load the separate descriptor and enclosing banner assets before host start
cases.expected: Strict hashes/bounds/provenance/readiness; no BIN, original EXE, C/emulator or runtime PS1 math dependency.

cases.action: Plan any entry/release continuation and visual comparison
cases.expected: Use a finite verified plan; distinguish queued/submitted/displayed frames and missing observations; source timing is not measured duration.

cases.action: Run existing standalone banners, Ready and authored introduction/battle
cases.expected: Outputs, rules and strict old profiles remain unchanged; this worker does not admit retail EventEnd or full startup.
